references.text: Israel's practice of offering peace before war, as when they sent messengers to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with words of peace
The Gibeonites sought peace with Israel and were spared, illustrating the principle of offering peace before attack
The Gibeonites came to Joshua with a covenant of peace, showing how people could choose peace over war
No city made peace with the children of Israel except the Hivites who lived in Gibeon; they took all others by force
Israel sent messengers to the Benjaminites with an offer of peace at the rock of Rimmon
David sent messengers to comfort Hanun, demonstrating diplomatic practice in seeking peace
Jesus instructed his disciples to greet a house with peace when they entered, reflecting the principle of offering peace first
The parable of the king considering whether he can meet another king in war, or if he should send a delegation to ask for terms of peace
